packageRules.description: A new member minor is proposed as a pull request so Edition CI tests it, and lands with the next edition release, never by auto-merge (docs/decisions/0001-typo3-ai-edition.md)

All member updates go into one pull request. The members require each other's minor ranges (the feature extensions require one nr-llm minor, nr-llm requires an nr-vault floor), so a new minor of one member does not resolve next to the old ranges of the others: the single pull requests for nr-llm ~0.51.0 and nr-mcp-agent ~0.39.0 failed Edition CI on exactly that, and only the combined raise in the 1.1.0 release resolved. separateMajorMinor false keeps a member major in the same pull request instead of a second one that cannot resolve alone.
The supported TYPO3 LTS changes only by decision, with a major edition release
